blocks.html: Search the nearby bookcases until you obtain The Shiny Scarab.

blocks.html: Follow the golden scarab at the locations indicated on the map on the right until you reach the Scabarite Cavern.

substeps.html: Teleporting directly to the cavern will not work.

substeps.html: Don't miss the final golden scarab spot directly in front of the cavern. Doing so will cause you to have to repeat the entire path from Menaphos.

blocks.html: Enter the cave entrance.
blocks.text: Enter the cave entrance.

blocks.html: Head south and follow the golden scarab once more.
blocks.text: Head south and follow the golden scarab once more.

blocks.html: Scavenge the piles of debris in the cavern until you have five sets of boat materials. If a Profane Scabarite appears, it must be killed to obtain the materials. Teleporting out will result in loss of materials.
blocks.text: Scavenge the piles of debris in the cavern until you have five sets of boat materials. If a Profane Scabarite appears, it must be killed to obtain the materials. Teleporting out will result in loss of materials.

blocks.html: Travel with the old boat.

blocks.html: Head east and up the steps and talk to Scabaras.
blocks.text: Head east and up the steps and talk to Scabaras.

blocks.html: Go back down the steps and interact with Fear. You need to keep interacting with Fear to scare it up the steps to Scabaras. Guide it up the northern side of the steps as it is more likely to get stuck on the southern side.
blocks.text: Go back down the steps and interact with Fear. You need to keep interacting with Fear to scare it up the steps to Scabaras. Guide it up the northern side of the steps as it is more likely to get stuck on the southern side.
